description: Work Hub (work-hub/) health checks. NOT run by default: adlc-lh:check-health reads only repo-health-checks.json. Run them only when asked (or when a task changes work-hub/), by passing this file's checks and environmentNotes to the adlc-lh:check-health-wf Workflow (finalRun true includes the work-hub-scenarios-* ones), or run the commands by hand from work-hub/ (CLAUDE.md, Work Hub).
environmentNotes: Work Hub (work-hub/, a separate Rust + bun product) has its own work-hub-* checks: they need Rust 1.92 (work-hub/rust-toolchain.toml), bun 1.4.4 and `npm ci` in work-hub/ plus `bun install` in work-hub/web/. work-hub-contract and work-hub-scenarios-a/b/c also need Docker running (they create containers, volumes and images labelled with their own instance and remove them afterwards), Postgres and — for mode b — Mailpit from the same tests/scenarios/docker-compose.yml; the first run builds the default container image artisyn-work-hub-default (npm run image in work-hub/, needs the network once) and the fake-agent test image, later runs reuse them. The Work Hub API contract suite (npm run test:contract from work-hub/) is deliberately NOT a health check for now: workspaces::create_login_patch_delete still assumes the old per-workspace login model and fails until it is rewritten — run it manually.

checks.name: work-hub-lint
checks.module: Work Hub lint (rustfmt, clippy, eslint, agent-name and licence checks)
checks.instructions: Fix all errors: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, the web eslint, scripts/agent-names-check.mjs (AC-2: the agent's name only in server/src/agent/claude.rs and agent/mod.rs, never in web/src) and scripts/license-check.mjs. Never silence clippy with allow attributes to pass — fix the root cause. Work Hub's own check (NFR-5): never part of Log Hub's build, dist/ or its checks. Needs no DB, no Docker and no running app — Rust-only builds compile without web/dist (rust-embed allow_missing). The first run compiles the Cargo workspace into work-hub/target, hence the long budget; later runs are incremental.

checks.name: work-hub-typecheck
checks.module: Work Hub typecheck (tsc over web/ and tests/)
checks.instructions: Zero type errors. Vite and Playwright strip types without checking them, so this is the only check that typechecks the Work Hub web UI and its browser suites (Rust is typechecked by clippy in work-hub-lint). Never weaken a type or add `any`/`as` to silence it. Work Hub's own check (NFR-5): never part of Log Hub's build, dist/ or its checks. Needs no DB, no Docker and no running app — Rust-only builds compile without web/dist (rust-embed allow_missing). The first run compiles the Cargo workspace into work-hub/target, hence the long budget; later runs are incremental.

checks.name: work-hub-algo
checks.module: Work Hub algorithm tests (cargo test algo + vitest)
checks.instructions: Doc-driven table tests only: server/tests/algo.rs reads docs/algorithm-examples/{workhub-*,password-policy,login-backoff,auth-startup-config,local-request-detection}.json and web/src/terminal/replay.algo.test.ts reads workhub-terminal-replay.json. Change rows in the rows files, never inline tables; never add other unit tests. Work Hub's own check (NFR-5): never part of Log Hub's build, dist/ or its checks. Needs no DB, no Docker and no running app — Rust-only builds compile without web/dist (rust-embed allow_missing). The first run compiles the Cargo workspace into work-hub/target, hence the long budget; later runs are incremental.

checks.name: work-hub-build
checks.instructions: Zero compilation errors. Builds work-hub/web/dist and the release binary into work-hub/target only — it never touches Log Hub's dist/ or server/src/public/static, so it is safe in the `static` group. The first release build is long; later ones are incremental.

checks.name: work-hub-scenarios-a
checks.module: Work Hub scenarios, auth mode none
checks.instructions: scripts/scenarios.mjs builds the web and the release binary, the fake-agent image (and the default image when missing), starts its own server on a free port in a fresh whs_a_* schema with its own WORK_HUB_INSTANCE, runs Playwright (tests/playwright.config.ts, project mode-a) and then drops the schema and removes only the Docker objects labelled with its instance. Needs Docker, Postgres (tests/scenarios/docker-compose.yml) and Chromium. It never touches Log Hub's dev server, DB schema or dist/. One integrated run per mode on purpose: if it outgrows its budget, raise timeoutSeconds rather than splitting it by --grep.
